text: Our refund policy allows returns within 30 days of purchase. Items must be in original packaging with a receipt.
Remote work policy (2022): employees may work remotely up to 10 days per year.
Remote work policy (2024): employees may work fully remotely. Prior approval from direct manager is required.
Travel Expenses (2024): Flights must be booked economy class unless flight duration exceeds 8 hours. Hotel budget is capped at $200 per night.
Travel Expenses (2023): Flights must be booked economy class. Hotel budget is capped at $150 per night.
Equipment Usage (2024): Laptops are upgraded every 3 years. Personal use of company laptops is strictly prohibited. Use VPN for all external networks.
Equipment Usage (2022): Laptops are upgraded every 4 years. Personal use of company laptops is allowed with restrictions.
Paid Time Off (2024): Employees receive 20 days of paid vacation annually. Up to 5 days can carry over to the next year.
Sick Leave (2024): Employees are entitled to 10 paid sick days per year. A doctor's note is required for consecutive sick leaves exceeding 3 days.
Code of Conduct (2024): We enforce a zero-tolerance policy against discrimination and harassment. All employees must complete annual compliance training.
Data Security (2024): Passwords must be at least 14 characters long and changed every 90 days. Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for all internal tools.
Vendor Onboarding (2024): All new vendors must pass a security review and sign an NDA before engaging in business. Vendor contracts must be renewed annually.
Office Access (2024): ID badges must be visible at all times. Visitors must be signed in at the front desk and escorted while on premises.
Expense Reimbursement (2024): All expense reports must be submitted within 15 days of the transaction. Receipts are required for any expense over $25.
Social Media Policy (2024): Employees must state that opinions are their own when posting about the company. Confidential information must not be shared.
